text:
maya: FYI CI alert on structured-output evals for llama3-q4f. Function-call metrics are way off. Test harness failing schema checks but model outputs look fine locally.
sam: error logs?
maya: snippet from CI runner logs:
```
runner ERROR: JSONSchemaValidatorError: field 'tool_name' missing at index 34
expected properties: {"name","args"} got {"name"}
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
```
li: Could be our post-processing. Are we normalizing `tool_name` vs `name`? Recent bump of runner-parser to v1.3.2?
maya: yep CI image pulled in parser v1.3.2 automatically. Locally I pin to v1.3.0 and tests pass.
andre: That would explain it. But dashboard also shows function_call_accuracy dropping from 0.93 -> 0.4 for the quantized run. Metric calc currently treats schema-parse failures as incorrect calls.
eva: Proposal: add two metrics: `function_call_parsable_rate` (passes JSON schema) and `function_call_semantic_accuracy` (call name+args match expected, tolerant to key order and extra keys).
sam: Also found a CI wiring bug: structured-output job golden_examples path points to `/goldens/old_schema/` instead of `/goldens/v2/`. Opening a PR to fix.
devops-bot: [deploy] image redwood/runner:prod-2026-03-05 deployed to ci-runners
maya: quick mitigation: pin runner-parser to 1.3.0 in CI image and add a postprocess fallback that maps `{"name":...}` -> `{"name":..., "args": {}}`.
li: Can we add an integration test that simulates missing `args` so CI catches parser strictness regressions?
andre: yes, and gate the new model bring-ups: fail CI if `function_call_parsable_rate` < 0.98 for any new-variant job.
eva: I'll update the dashboards to add parsable_rate and semantic_accuracy broken down by model + quant config.
sam: created ticket RL-8792, PR #4512 with pinned dep + test + path fix. Requesting reviews.
maya: Reviewing now. If merged, will rerun the failing job.
li: quick note: quantized variants can change tokenization boundaries and occasionally split JSON blobs across tokens causing parse fragility. Add deterministic tokenization sanity checks in harness.
maya: good call, adding to the bring-up checklist.
andre: thanks everyone. Plan: merge PR, rerun CI, confirm parsable_rate > 0.98, then close RL-8792. :thumbsup:
